hero.description: Martial arts, personal training and osteopathy in one place in Calella.

muay_thai.subtitle: Art of 8 Limbs
muay_thai.about_desc: Originating in Thailand as a military combat system in the 13th century, Muay Thai is known worldwide as the "Art of 8 Limbs" using punches, elbows, knees, and shins.
muay_thai.train_desc: Our classes combine technique, metabolic conditioning, and functional coordination:
muay_thai.train_1: Warm-up & Cardio: Jump rope, shadowboxing, and mobility drills.
muay_thai.train_2: Technique & Pads: Direct work with trainers on focus mitts and Thai pads.
muay_thai.train_3: Clinch & Bag: Striking power, short-range work, and core strength.
muay_thai.b1_desc: Up to 800 kcal per session with full-body conditioning.
muay_thai.b2_desc: Dramatic improvement in aerobic endurance and speed.
muay_thai.b3_desc: Channel energy, focus, and find mental clarity.
muay_thai.b4_desc: Sharper reflexes and reaction speed in real scenarios.

boxing.subtitle: The Sweet Science
boxing.about_desc: Traced back to ancient Greek Olympics and codified in 18th-century Britain, boxing focuses on punches, footwork, and defensive slips.
boxing.train_desc: A round-by-round workout to build power, mental agility, and clean form:
boxing.train_1: Boxing Footwork: Pivots, steps, and ring awareness.
boxing.train_2: Pads & Heavy Bag: Combination drills (jab, cross, hook, uppercut).
boxing.train_3: Defense & Head Movement: Slips, rolls, and active blocks.
boxing.b1_desc: Boost hand-eye coordination and reaction time.
boxing.b2_desc: Tone shoulders, arms, abdominals, and back muscles.
boxing.b3_desc: Complete focus, reducing daily anxiety and stress.

defensa_personal.subtitle: Real Safety and Control
defensa_personal.about_desc: A modern, reality-based self-defense system designed to neutralize real-world threats quickly regardless of physical size.
defensa_personal.train_desc: Practical training focused on real conflict resolution:
defensa_personal.train_1: Escapes & Holds: Break free from wrist, choke, and body grabs.
defensa_personal.train_2: Vulnerable Targets: Efficient strikes to soft targets with minimal effort.
defensa_personal.train_3: Stress Drills: Practice under simulated high-pressure scenarios.
defensa_personal.b1_desc: Build street confidence and emotional composure.
defensa_personal.b2_desc: Develop threat detection and situational awareness.
defensa_personal.b4_desc: Tailored for all fitness levels, ages, and genders.

jjb.subtitle: Human Chess
jjb.about_desc: Developed in Brazil by the Gracie family, BJJ is a ground fighting martial art focusing on grappling, joint locks, and chokes through leverage.
jjb.train_desc: Classes centered around control, takedowns, and submissions:
jjb.train_1: Ground Mobility: Guard passes, sweeps, and hip escapes.
jjb.train_2: Submission Attacks: Joint locks and chokes applied safely.
jjb.b1_desc: Enhance strategic thinking and problem-solving under pressure.
jjb.b2_desc: Dramatically improve joint mobility and core power.
jjb.b3_desc: No head strikes; ideal for long-term health.

muay_thai_kids.subtitle: Values & Youth
muay_thai_kids.about_desc: A fun pedagogical martial arts program for kids. We teach Muay Thai fundamentals through games, martial discipline, and core values.
muay_thai_kids.train_1: Agility Games: Obstacle courses and coordination drills.
muay_thai_kids.train_2: Pad Work: Soft striking on padded targets.
muay_thai_kids.train_3: Values Education: Traditional respect, focus, and teamwork.
muay_thai_kids.b2_desc: Encourage respect for coaches, peers, and rules.
muay_thai_kids.b3_desc: Improve posture, balance, and child agility.
muay_thai_kids.b4_desc: Help manage hyperactivity and school stress.

about.lead:
Since 1989, I have dedicated myself to the art of Muay Thai, a passion that has been a constant in my life. Over the years, I have refined my technique and immersed myself in the philosophy surrounding this sport.

As a competitor, I have faced great challenges, learning valuable lessons in every fight.

Our goal is to help you build confidence, discipline, and mental strength in a supportive and motivating environment.
about.val1_desc: Push your limits and gain confidence in every session.
about.val2_desc: Daily consistency is the true key to progress.
about.val3_desc: Train alongside a supportive team and fellow members.

faq.subtitle: Common Questions
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our classes, schedules, and facility rules.
faq.q1: Do I need prior experience to start training?
faq.a1: Not at all. Our classes are adapted for all levels, from complete beginners to advanced athletes. Our trainers will guide you step by step.
faq.q2: What gear do I need to bring on my first day?
faq.a2: For your first session, you only need comfortable sportswear, a water bottle, and a towel. Specific technical equipment (such as guards or gloves) will be provided, or we will advise you on what to buy.
faq.q3: Do you offer a trial class?
faq.a3: Yes! You can request a trial class with no obligation by contacting us via phone, WhatsApp, or directly at reception. The cost of the class is €10. If you sign up afterwards, this amount will be deducted from your registration or membership fee.
faq.q4: What are the payment and membership options?
faq.a4: We offer monthly memberships and session passes depending on your training frequency. You can pay your fee directly at reception.
faq.q5: Are there locker rooms available at the center?
faq.a5: Yes, we have fully equipped locker rooms so you can change and store your belongings during the session.
